models_used.note: N=100, R_BURDEN=6.65 sourced from elec/src/modules.ato (read-only). RW=50 (winding resistance) is the subckt's own default, NOT verified against the real CST2010-100L datasheet.
Vendor-provenance behavioural port. Its own header states it 'does not claim a timing, noise, or temperature model' -- propagation delay is NOT measurable with this model.

verdict.propagation_delay_reason: TLV3201_ngspice.lib declares no timing model; a measured delay from this model would be a modelling artifact (~picoseconds), not physical, and is deliberately not reported as an OCP-01 latency figure.
verdict.summary: Simulated OCP trip current is 37.61 A (uncalibrated). This FALLS OUTSIDE the OCP-01 45-55 A spec window and matches the CurrentSensing module's own inline design-intent comment (~37.6 A), NOT its sibling OCPComparator docstring's claimed 50 A threshold. That mismatch is a real, pre-existing discrepancy between the committed resistor values and the stated requirement; this harness surfaces it but does not resolve it (no schematic/elec changes were made).
